method: Pinned git-show reads of two graph records, three representative-structure records and retained grounding dossiers; independent targeted reading of the cited primary papers and current RCSB entry metadata. No PTM edits, Git mutations, GitHub writes, session interactions, provider sweeps or paid API calls.
conclusion: No new actionable scientific defect confirmed in the narrow reviewed scope. This is a scientific review result, not human approval or permission to merge.

assessments.assessment: Graph confines the mechanism to KRAS(G12C) and tested inhibitor molecules. The local covalent-capture process avoids noncovalent GO-binding conflation; the local ligand-set node avoids equating a biochemical role with a molecule. The primary study supports cysteine-dependent capture, nucleotide preference change and impaired Raf association. It does not create a qualified UniProt occurrence. CHEBI:29950 is independently identifiable as L-cysteine residue through official ontology cross-reference metadata.
source_locators: Ostrem et al. abstract; Figure 3 and nucleotide-affinity paragraph; Figure 4 and Raf co-immunoprecipitation paragraph
assessments.limit: No independent reanalysis of biochemical data or atom/residue mapping. The graph summarizes a source study, not a universal allosteric mechanism.

assessments.assessment: Graph is explicitly KcsA-specific. Its carbonyl-mediated potassium-coordination/selectivity interpretation and contribution to conduction agree with the cited primary abstract. It retains the distinction between a source structural interpretation and a universal channel mechanism or geometry-only functional annotation.
assessments.limit: No coordinate reanalysis or contemporary selectivity-mechanism synthesis; review judges the conservatively attributed original-study claim.

assessments.assessment: PDB:1LMB version 1.3 is a conservative whole-entry anchor for a source-described HTH region. RCSB verifies lambda repressor chains C/D (author 3/4), X-ray 1.8 A and PMID:1387915. The record explicitly withholds motif bounds and qualified UniProt occurrence.
source_locators: Entry version and experimental-data snapshot; primary citation abstract; protein entity 3 chain table
assessments.limit: No local HTH residue selection or SIFTS/UniProt qualification.

assessments.assessment: PDB:1BXL version 1.4, solution NMR, Bcl-xL chain A/Bak peptide chain B, is supported by RCSB and its primary citation PMID:9020082. The interface-containing representative does not claim exact contacts or a qualified UniProt occurrence. The retained dossier flags inconsistent source organism metadata rather than using it for protein qualification.
source_locators: Entry version and method; primary citation abstract; protein entity chain tables
assessments.limit: No contact computation or qualified species/isoform mapping.

assessments.assessment: PDB:2CBA version 1.5, human carbonic anhydrase II chain A, X-ray, and zinc-site source PMID:1433293 are supported by RCSB metadata and the primary abstract. The representative explicitly withholds exact donor atoms and a qualified UniProt occurrence.
source_locators: Entry version and experimental snapshot; primary abstract; protein entity chain table
assessments.limit: No donor-atom selection, coordination calculation or UniProt qualification.

status_preservation: All five reviewed records retain PROPOSED. No human review status conferred.
limitations: This supplemental review covers two graphs and three representative structures, not all 24 records or all PR artifacts.
No full pipeline validation or generated-browser audit in this narrow subtask.
The PDB anchors remain representative structures; zero qualified examples is not treated as completed occurrence curation.
Reads of tracked content use the exact Git tree and therefore do not depend on gitignore filtering. No corpus-wide absence claim is made.
external_fetch_notes: PubMed PMID:24256730 timed out on one fetch; its primary full text PMC4274051 was independently read successfully.
Legacy ChEBI detail URL was inaccessible; official QuickGO/ChEBI indexed metadata confirmed CHEBI:29950 identity.
